title: Salary-related Claims Filed with TADM Involving Workers Paid in Cash
what_it_is: Salary-related Claims Filed with TADM Involving Workers Paid in Cash

sections.label: Cash salary claims and electronic payment
sections.summary: Salary claims involving cash-paid workers rose from about 28% of 8,125 claims in 2023 to about 36% of 10,801 claims in 2025, and MOM is studying mandating electronic salary payment.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: The number of salary claims filed at the Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management (TADM) and the proportion involving workers who were paid in cash is as follows: (a) in 2023, about 28% of 8,125 claims; (b) in 2024, about 33% of 9,948 claims; and (c) in 2025, about 36% of 10,801 claims.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: The upward trend in the proportion of claims involving cash-paid workers underscores the risks associated with cash salary arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: Electronic salary payment strengthens the documentary trail and helps prevent salary disputes by leaving a verifiable digital record.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: As part of the ongoing review of the Employment Act, MOM and our tripartite partners are studying whether to mandate electronic salary payment for all workers, including migrant workers.

sections.label: Support for unpaid salary workers
sections.summary: MOM will support workers affected by unpaid salaries using the Short-Term Relief Fund and Migrant Workers Assistance Fund, and facilitate special passes and employment letters for valid claims.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: On his first question, we will continue to support all workers who are affected by situations like unpaid salaries, not just in terms of basic needs, but also smoothening the transition into jobs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We will use our Short-Term Relief Fund for local workers and the Migrant Workers Assistance Fund for migrant workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: MOM will also facilitate special passes and certificate of employment letters for valid claims.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: For employers who are not aware, the bank account opening can be done online and the bank cards can be mailed to the employers.
